summary: Iteration 2: tested the new email auth (register, login, lockout, forgot and reset password), Articoli e servizi CRUD, client VAT regime and dichiarazione d'intento (N3.5), cassa previdenziale and ritenuta d'acconto (totals, XML, print), and company defaults, plus regression of SDI send/refresh, numbering and users. Backend: 21 pytest, 20 pass. The 1 failure is the brute-force lockout, which does not work through the public ingress. Frontend: all tested flows work (Playwright, 1920px). Code review found a CRITICAL security hole: anyone can register with ADMIN_EMAIL and become admin at once.

critical.issue: Lockout key is f'{request.client.host}:{email}'. Behind the k8s ingress, client.host is the ingress pod IP and alternates (seen: 10.219.0.6 and 10.30.130.133), so failures are split across several counters. Over the public URL, 7 bad logins all returned 401 and none returned 429, and the correct password still logged in after 5 failures. Via localhost:8001 the lock works (429 on the 6th). Fix: key on email only, or on the first IP in X-Forwarded-For plus email.

SECURITY: is_admin = body.email == ADMIN_EMAIL and there is no email verification. fabrizio.gemignani@gmail.com is NOT in the db yet, so anyone can register with that email and any password and get role=admin, status=approved at once (full takeover). Same class of bug for other users: someone can pre-register a victim's email; when the victim later uses Google login they land in the attacker-created account, and the attacker still knows the password. Fix: never auto-promote on email/password register (only after Google login or a verified email), or require email verification before the account is usable. Found by code review only; not exploited, to avoid creating a real admin.

minor.issue: find_one then update is not atomic. Two parallel requests with the same token can both succeed. Use find_one_and_update({token_hash, used: False}, {$set: {used: True}}).
The index on articles.codice is not unique (create_index('codice')). The uniqueness check is app-level only, so a race can create duplicates. Make the index unique.

No check that the invoice date is not in the future. SDI rejects future-dated invoices (error 00403). Also, a stray future-dated invoice blocks numbering: an earlier draft (1/2026 dated 2026-10-29) made the 'data >= ultima fattura' rule reject all earlier dates.
The N3.5 check only looks at lines. If cassa.natura is N3.5 and no line is N3.5, the dichiarazione check is skipped and AltriDatiGestionali INTENTO is not written.

ui_bugs.issue: Changing from an exempt client (e.g. N3.5) to an ordinary client leaves all lines (and the cassa) at IVA 0% with the old natura. exempt() only applies when natura_default is set and never resets. The user must fix every line by hand, or the invoice is saved with a wrong 0% VAT.
Turning the cassa switch ON after an exempt client is selected uses defaultCassa (IVA 22%) and ignores the client's exemption. selectClient sets cassa IVA 0 only if the cassa was already on.

issues: The exemption banner shows the raw ISO date (del 2026-01-15) instead of 15/01/2026
The ritenuta amount '- 200,00 €' wraps onto 2 lines: the '-' sits on its own line because the label column is long. Add whitespace-nowrap to the amount.

passed_features: Register -> pending screen (UI + API). bcrypt $2b$ hash. httpOnly+Secure cookie. Duplicate email 400. Short password or bad email 422
Wrong login -> toast 'Email o password non corretti'. A Google-only user cannot log in with a password
/password-dimenticata -> forgot-success (non-existent email; no real email sent). Generic 200 for unknown email

Reset with an inserted token: password mismatch toast, success redirects to /login, new password works, old password 401, all sessions deleted, reused token 'Link non valido o già utilizzato', expired token 400 'scaduto'
/auth/me, /users and the Users page never expose password_hash
Articoli: create, edit, delete, duplicate codice 400 (toast), aliquota 0 without natura 422, natura select shown for 0%, invalid aliquota 422
Party N3.5: protocollo/data required (422 + toast), format validated, fields cleared when the regime changes
Editor: exempt client sets lines to 0% + N3.5 and shows the banner. add-article-select overrides the article's 22% with the exemption. N3.5 line + client without dichiarazione -> 422
Cassa/ritenuta: 1000 -> 1040 / 228.80 / 1268.80 / rit 200 / netto 1068.80. With cassa soggetta: 208 / 1060.80 (UI summary + backend + print)
XML: DatiRitenuta, DatiCassaPrevidenziale, Ritenuta SI on lines (and in cassa when soggetta), a single INTENTO AltriDatiGestionali, ImportoPagamento = netto, element order matches the XSD
Settings defaults saved. A new invoice starts with the cassa and ritenuta switches on, using TC04/RT01 from the defaults
Regression: SDI send -> inviata -> refresh -> consegnata, editor locked after send, numbering sequential, Users page lists the new email-registered users
action_items: CRITICAL: block auto-admin on email/password register for ADMIN_EMAIL (and address pre-registration takeover, e.g. require email verification or only grant admin via Google login)
Fix the login lockout identifier (email only or X-Forwarded-For) so it works behind the ingress
Reset line VAT/natura (and cassa natura) when changing from an exempt client to an ordinary one in InvoiceEditor
Make reset-token consumption atomic; make the articles.codice index unique
Optional: reject future invoice dates; format the date in the exemption banner; nowrap the ritenuta amount on the print page
critical_code_review_comments: server.py register(): is_admin from an unverified email -> privilege escalation
server.py login(): request.client.host behind the proxy makes the lockout ineffective
server.py is 776 lines (>700): split auth/articles/invoices into routers
CORS_ORIGINS='*' with allow_credentials=True; set explicit origins for production
reset_password: rejected users can still reset (forgot blocks them, but a token issued earlier still works); minor

success_rate.frontend: 100% of tested flows functional (1 medium + 1 low UX bug)

test_credentials: Seeded tokens via mongosh /app/backend/tests/seed_sessions.js (test_session_T1_admin_approved, etc.). Email user test.user.t2uireset@example.com / NewPassword1 (pending).
seed_data_creation: Parties TEST_T2_UI_Esportatore (N3.5, prot 12345678901234567-000123 del 2026-01-15) and TEST_T2_UI_Ordinario. Articles TEST_T2_UI_CONS (22%, 175), TEST_T2_UI_ESE (0% N4). Invoices 2/2026 (consegnata, cassa+ritenuta) and 3/2026 (bozza, N3.5). Pending users test.user.t2ui*@example.com. Company cassa/ritenuta defaults reset to none after the test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run: mongosh --quiet /app/backend/tests/seed_sessions.js && cd /app/backend/tests && python -m pytest test_iteration2_features.py -n 0 -v. Use -n 0: pytest.ini uses xdist loadscope, and the module cleanup fixture races across workers. The module cleanup deletes TEST_T2_* parties and their invoices, articles and test.user.t2* users. The container date is 2026-10-29; the tests use invoice date 2026-11-02. test_bruteforce_lockout is expected to fail until the identifier is fixed. Do not call forgot-password for existing users more than once (real email).
rca of the issue: Lockout: counters stored per '<client.host>:<email>'. Mongo showed 2 docs for the same email (10.219.0.6 count 3, 10.30.130.133 count 4) after 7 failures, so neither reached 5. Repro: 6 bad POST /api/auth/login on the public URL -> all 401 (the 6th should be 429). Via localhost:8001 the 6th is 429. Mitigation: identifier = email, or the first X-Forwarded-For IP + email.
